verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada delivers its registry through software (the Online Filing Centre), so asking whether that software's source is published under an open license is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows any source repository or open license. The open.canada.ca CKAN probe concerns open data access, which is an adjacent capability, not open source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
